title: Pre-existing dead-field warning: EngramRootReconcileOutcome::Confirmed.fence is never read
outcome: cargo check reports no dead-code warning for EngramRootReconcileOutcome::Confirmed's fence field: the field is either read where the confirmation is consumed, or removed.
acceptance: `cargo check --bin termal` reports no `field fence is never read` warning for src/engram_root_authority.rs
If the field is kept, a behavioural test shows the confirmed fence is used by its consumer; if it is removed, no behaviour changes and the existing root-reconcile tests pass
